titles.romaji: Otome wa Boku ni Koishiteru: Mittsu no Kiraboshi - The Animation (2022)
titles.native: 処女はお姉さまに恋してる 三つのきら星 The Animation

description:
Based on the erotic game by Caramel BOX.

The daughter of a very powerful family has her eyes set on one specific person, but as it turns out, "she" isn't who she seems to be...
